name: Round the Mulberry Bush
source:
A visual novel set in the late 18th century, about an impossible 'romance' between a young Lady and a stableboy.

Watch as their relationship falls apart over the course of seven long, lazy summers.

[From [url=https://ebihime.itch.io/mulberries]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以18世纪末为背景的视觉小说，讲述年轻贵族小姐与马夫之间不可能的“爱情”。

看着他们的关系在七个漫长而慵懒的夏天里逐渐崩塌。

[来源：[url=https://ebihime.itch.io/mulberries]itch.io[/url]]
